## Key points

- **Reconciliation revamp is the Q3 anchor.** Build wins over buy. Recur costs $180K/yr and LedgerFlow costs $140K/yr but lacks jurisdiction-specific tax codes. Both would still need about 3 engineer-weeks of integration.
- The rewrite is about 6 engineer-weeks and includes migrating the FX rounding module. It needs Karim from platform for 2 of those weeks on ledger integration. It addresses multi-currency batch failures: 3 incidents this quarter and a 40% QoQ rise in support tickets.
- **Mobile receipt-capture ships v1 without bulk-select.** Bulk-select would add about a sprint. It goes on the roadmap as a fast-follow.
- Testing with six users also showed the OCR confidence indicator needs to be much more prominent. Dan is updating the specs.
- **Vendor payout SLA plan:** the target is payout within 48h of invoice approval, up from a current p95 of 71h. Two changes would get there by mid-Q3:
  - Eng cuts the ACH batching window from 12h to 4h. This costs about half a sprint plus SRE sign-off, and adds monitoring load.
  - Ops adds a second approver on the west-coast shift.
- It is conditional on a trade-off analysis. If SRE says the monitoring load is manageable, proceed. Otherwise, look at intermediate targets.
- **Audit-log retention update is pushed to Q4**, confirmed with Legal.
- The internal admin-tool refresh stays with the intern crew, unchanged.
- **On-call rotation ask:** HR flagged a spike in engineering bug-bash burnout. Marcus will propose a rotating on-call structure. A small proposal is enough.

## Action items

- Priya: Circulate the Q3 scope draft for review, Thursday morning (before Friday's scope lock)
- Priya: Put reconciliation in as the Q3 anchor and add the bulk-select fast-follow note to the roadmap, in the scope draft (by Friday lock)
- Marcus: Sync with Karim's manager and confirm Karim's availability for 2 weeks, this week
- Marcus: Complete the ACH batching trade-off analysis, including SRE input, and bring it back next week
- Marcus: Propose a rotating on-call structure, by the 31st
- Jenna: Pair with Marcus on the ACH trade-off analysis, next week
- Dan: Update the mobile receipt-capture specs (no bulk-select; more prominent OCR confidence indicator), by Wednesday
- Sara: Take the Q3 scope to the exec review, Monday

Note: The meeting was on 2026-08-27, so the dates above have already passed as of today (2026-09-21). Please check them against current status.
